description: A gray plastic tub with ice cubes sits on the table next to a small yellow cup, and a purple scoop lies to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and dips it into the tub to gather ice, while the left hand steadies the tub briefly; then the left hand lifts and holds the yellow cup as the right hand moves the scoop over and tips it so the ice slides into the cup before setting the scoop back down.
